meta.title: Key stage 4 headline measures by secondary school (Bedfordshire)
meta.geography: point (schools in Bedford, Central Bedfordshire, Luton)
meta.quality: School performance tables data (accredited official statistics); latest year provisional. Coordinates from GIAS by URN.
meta.limitations: State-funded mainstream schools with KS4 cohorts only; independent schools are not in this data set. Small-cohort and disclosive values are suppressed (c/x/z/low -> null, suppressed:true). A URN changes when a school converts to an academy, so history for a site can sit under two URNs.

indicators.label: School average Attainment 8
indicators.description: Average Attainment 8 score for the school's end-of-KS4 cohort.

indicators.label: School % grade 5+ English and maths
indicators.description: Percentage of the school's pupils achieving 5+ in English and maths.

indicators.label: School % grade 4+ English and maths
indicators.description: Percentage achieving 4+ in English and maths.

indicators.label: School end-of-KS4 cohort
indicators.description: Number of pupils at the end of KS4 in the school.
